title: Tooltip
summary: A short label for the control it wraps, shown on hover, on keyboard focus and on a touch long press. Placed beside the target and flipped when it would leave the screen.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred side; flips when it does not fit.

props.name: delay
props.description: Mouse hover delay; focus is immediate.

props.name: interactive
props.description: A hint card: the panel stays open while the pointer is over it, a tap on touch toggles it, and it can hold links and rich content.

props.name: help
props.description: Draws its own info button as the target (the default slot then holds text that follows it).

props.name: enrich
props.description: Underlines the wrapped value with a dotted line to show it has context.

props.name: heading
props.description: A bold heading inside the panel.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the built-in info button.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Rich tip content in place of text.

slots.name: links
slots.description: Links shown under the panel text (a doc link, a more link).

writes.why: The tip text is also the target accessible description (an id in the shadow tree cannot reach the target). Set only when the target has none, taken off again when the text or the target changes and when the tooltip disconnects. The single write that is undone on disconnect.

a11y: The tip is a role=tooltip node in the shadow tree, and the slotted target gets aria-description with the same text (an accessible description: nothing is added to your markup, and no id has to cross the shadow boundary; a target that already has its own aria-description keeps it). Escape hides it. Wrap a focusable element (button, link); never the only way to learn something essential.
mobile: Touch shows it after a 500ms press and hides it on the next touch; text is 14px and wraps at 20rem.

examples.title: Tooltip on hover, focus and long press
examples.html: <pk-cluster><pk-tooltip text="Saves the draft without publishing"><pk-button variant="ghost">Save draft</pk-button></pk-tooltip><pk-tooltip text="Opens to the right" placement="right"><pk-button variant="ghost">Right</pk-button></pk-tooltip></pk-cluster>
